name: Origen
notes: 3 photos: a tequila list and a cocktail list were drink-only and skipped; the 'del mar' seafood page had 10 clearly priced, described dishes and is the sole source below.

dishes.name: Flautitas de atun ahumado (3 pc)

dishes.name: Ceviche de salmon con leche de tigre de Jamaica

dishes.name: Croquetas de jaiba y poblano
dishes.description: Blue crab, slow-roasted poblano bits, house cilantro aioli

dishes.name: Tostada de jaiba

dishes.name: Taco de camarones
dishes.description: A la macha shrimps, adobado beans, roasted peppers and chile seco salsa

dishes.name: Pulpo a la salsa macha
